context_isolation_probe.dispatch: named subagent, not a fork — a fork inherits the whole conversation and is never isolated
context_isolation_probe.negative_arm: marker held only by the dispatching loop: NOT_VISIBLE; no prior conversation, no other agent's output, no Founder request
context_isolation_probe.control_arm: marker placed in the dispatch: quoted back exactly — the probe can see a marker when one is there
context_isolation_probe.earlier_observations: 2026-09-10 general-purpose dispatch with both arms (M4); a Quality Engineer canary probe from a separate session
context_isolation_probe.does_not_cover: the filesystem, the git history and the session transcript on disk are shared; the dispatch prompt is written by the Invoker; it is the same model as the builder
